notifications.popups.outcome: Notifications sent to org.freedesktop.Notifications appear as themed popups with distinct normal and critical styling.

notifications.actions.outcome: A notification's actions can be invoked through the provider's own interface (click, menu or client command).

notifications.dismiss.outcome: notifications.dismiss.all removes every shown popup natively and completes only when the provider then reports none shown (accepted where no readback exists). notifications.primary (the bar's left click) runs notifications.center.toggle for SwayNC and notifications.dismiss.all for mako, dunst and fnott, matching the v0.7.0 gestures.

notifications.dnd.outcome: notifications.dnd.set/toggle change the native do-not-disturb state and complete only when the readback matches; while on, ordinary popups are hidden and critical ones still appear.

notifications.history.outcome: notifications.history.open shows a native view in which retained notifications can be browsed.

notifications.center.outcome: notifications.center.toggle opens or closes the provider's notification center and completes when its visibility readback changed.

notifications.status.outcome: status_read.sh notifications reports running, dnd, count, history_count, center_visible and inhibited from native readback, null when not observable, without starting a daemon or exposing notification content.

notifications.retention.outcome: Native history keeps at most 100 entries and drops entries older than 24 hours, both while running and before display after a restart (policy P03).

notifications.transient.outcome: Notifications marked transient by the sender are not kept in the native history.

notifications.singleton.outcome: role_exec.sh notifications starts the selected provider only when nobody owns org.freedesktop.Notifications, does nothing when the selected provider owns it, and refuses a foreign owner with exit 10 without terminating it.

notifications.lock_privacy.outcome: While the session is locked no notification popup or content is visible, including critical notifications.

notifications/swaync.summary: Popups, actions, dismissal, do-not-disturb with critical exception, browsable center and full status; no native history limits.
limitations: SwayNC has no native history limit or 24-hour expiry: the control center keeps every notification until it is cleared or SwayNC restarts.
Dismiss all hides popups and keeps them in the control center (SwayNC's history).
notifications/swaync.data_boundary: Notifications live in SwayNC's memory only and are gone after a restart; nothing is migrated or logged.

notifications.dismiss.note: swaync-client --hide-all; popups are not counted separately, so the outcome is accepted.

notifications.dnd.note: Critical popups still appear during DND by default.

notifications.history.note: The control center lists retained notifications with their actions.

notifications.status.note: history_count is null because the control-center count already includes retained entries.

notifications.retention.note: No configuration key caps the control center or expires entries by age; nothing persists across restarts.

notifications.singleton.note: Owner PID and comm from the D-Bus daemon; a second daemon also refuses to replace an owner.

notifications.lock_privacy.note: ext-session-lock-v1 requires the compositor to hide normal surfaces while locked and the repository enables no above_lock or session_lock_xray exception; checked in the VM with hyprlock.

theme.note: Rendered color/font region in the shipped style.css, reloaded with swaync-client --reload-css (E-D03-013, E-D03-035).

notifications/mako.summary: Popups, actions, dismissal, do-not-disturb with critical exception and status; history is kept (100 entries) but cannot be browsed.
limitations: Mako has no view to browse its history; the history action explains this (makoctl restore only shows the latest entry again).
Mako has no notification center and no 24-hour history expiry; history is lost when mako restarts.
Mako keeps sender-marked transient notifications in its history.
notifications/mako.data_boundary: Notifications and up to 100 history entries live in mako's memory only; nothing is migrated or logged.

notifications.dismiss.note: makoctl dismiss --all; dismissed entries move to history.

notifications.dnd.note: Mode do-not-disturb from the managed mako unit hides ordinary popups and keeps critical ones; without that unit the mode has no visible effect.

notifications.history.note: makoctl history only lists entries for scripts and restore re-shows one entry; there is no browsing view.

notifications.retention.note: max-history=100 is managed; mako has no age-based expiry and keeps no history across restarts.

notifications.transient.note: Mako has no transient criterion; transient notifications enter its history.

notifications.singleton.note: Owner PID and comm from the D-Bus daemon; a second daemon also refuses to replace an owner.

notifications.lock_privacy.note: ext-session-lock-v1 requires the compositor to hide normal surfaces while locked and the repository enables no above_lock or session_lock_xray exception; checked in the VM with hyprlock.

theme.note: include= of a generated file from a managed region at the top of ~/.config/mako/config, reloaded with makoctl reload (E-D03-020, E-D03-035, E-D03-036).

notifications/dunst.summary: Popups, actions, dismissal, do-not-disturb with critical exception and status; history is kept (100 entries) but cannot be browsed.
limitations: Dunst has no view to browse its history; the history action explains this (dunstctl history-pop only shows the latest entry again).
Dunst has no notification center and no 24-hour history expiry; history is lost when dunst restarts.
Applying the theme creates a user dunstrc, after which dunst no longer reads /etc/dunst/dunstrc.
notifications/dunst.data_boundary: Notifications and up to 100 history entries live in dunst's memory only; nothing is migrated or logged.

notifications.actions.note: Click, dunstctl action or the native context menu.

notifications.dismiss.note: dunstctl close-all; closed entries move to history.

notifications.dnd.note: set-paused with readback; critical notifications appear because the managed region sets override_pause_level = 100.

notifications.history.note: dunstctl history lists entries for scripts and history-pop re-shows one entry; there is no browsing view.

notifications.status.note: count is displayed plus waiting; center_visible and inhibited are null.

notifications.retention.note: history_length = 100 is managed; dunst has no age-based expiry and keeps no history across restarts.

notifications.transient.note: Managed rule match_transient = yes, history_ignore = yes.

notifications.singleton.note: Owner PID and comm from the D-Bus daemon; a second daemon also refuses to replace an owner.

notifications.lock_privacy.note: ext-session-lock-v1 requires the compositor to hide normal surfaces while locked and the repository enables no above_lock or session_lock_xray exception; checked in the VM with hyprlock.

theme.note: Managed region at the top of ~/.config/dunst/dunstrc (dunst has no include and ignores drop-ins without a user dunstrc), reloaded with dunstctl reload (E-D03-022, E-D03-035, E-D03-036).

notifications/fnott.summary: Popups, actions, dismissal and status work; Fnott has no do-not-disturb readback and no notification history.
limitations: Fnott cannot report whether it is paused and pausing also hides critical notifications, so do-not-disturb is unsupported.
Fnott keeps no notification history and has no notification center.
Theme changes apply the next time fnott starts (fnott has no reload).
notifications/fnott.data_boundary: Notifications live in fnott's memory only and are gone when dismissed; nothing is migrated or logged.

notifications.actions.note: Click or fnottctl actions with fnott's selection helper.

notifications.dismiss.note: fnottctl dismiss all with fnottctl list readback.

notifications.dnd.note: fnottctl pause has no readback and also hides critical notifications.

notifications.status.note: running and count only; dnd, history_count, center_visible and inhibited are null.

notifications.singleton.note: Owner PID and comm from the D-Bus daemon; a second daemon also refuses to replace an owner.

notifications.lock_privacy.note: ext-session-lock-v1 requires the compositor to hide normal surfaces while locked and the repository enables no above_lock or session_lock_xray exception; checked in the VM with hyprlock.

theme.note: Managed keys in ~/.config/fnott/fnott.ini (no include; unknown keys are fatal, so only verified keys are written); applies on the next start (E-D03-027, E-D03-035).
